Selma Blair Arrested After Alleged Assault on Flight Attendants

Actress Selma Blair was arrested on Sunday at John F. Kennedy Airport in New York following an alleged incident on a Delta Air Lines flight from Los Angeles. She is accused of assaulting two flight attendants, with reports stating she punched one, bit another, and attempted to open a plane door. Blair was taken to a hospital for evaluation, as was one of the injured cabin crew members. She was charged with assault of a police officer and a nurse after her arrest.
